text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final stretch!
A burst of speed toward Derby glory!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Let's settle this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you!!
Not in this Derby, absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't yield, I won't yield!!
I'm going to win for Maruzen-san's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaah!!
Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...The shadow of defeat. An overwhelming force swallowing me whole――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into pieces!!
I will burn up this very life
and carve proof that I existed right here and now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!!
*I'm* going to win the Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(............No! As if I'd lose!
Like hell I'll go down hereeee!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I... I wiiiiiill... Aaaaagh, I willlll!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm the strongest of allllll!
Oraaaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Mejiro Ardan! First across the line is Mejiro Ardan!!
She has conquered the Japanese Derby!
(Woooooaaaaahhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Amazing... Ah, my heart is still trembling...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Chiyo-chan. Everyone.
That was a magnificent Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... *gasp*, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I lost...
Maruzen-san and my Derby is...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uuu... *sob* Waaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was amazing, Mejiro Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on becoming a Derby Umamusume!
Ramonu's little sister... no, Mejiro Ardan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I was able to leave behind...
the trajectory of this life... its brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ......Back then, I... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's intensity was incredible!
It gave me total chills!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a race!!
I could feel our souls clashing out there!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !? ...R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: That was an unforgettable, legendary showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
…………Ngh!
Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, Chiyono O-san.
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the ardent running from both of you,
we were able to create a race that will live on in memory and history."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —No thanks are necessary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I, too, am truly grateful
to Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The reason I was able to run like I did today
is because I was propelled by both of your strong feelings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to lose to that sheer tenacity...
I wanted to burn my soul and shine brightly,
just like the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A desire to seize victory even at the cost of everything.
That sheer obsession made both of their lives shine brightly.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was utterly captivated by the way both of you ran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Thank you very much.
To me, there is no praise more delightful...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Was I... able to shine too...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Chiyono O-san's running is also
burned vividly and brilliantly
into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope Maruzen-san
feels the same way..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With that smile, surely.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san, Ardan-san.
Thank you both for your burning determination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... thank you very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still! I won't lose next time!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I shall seize victory without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge!

They exchanged refreshing smiles and shook hands.
However, in stark contrast to that friendly air—

Upon returning to the waiting room, Yaeno Muteki wore a solemn
expression. She was smiling out on the turf, so what could be the matter?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I was reflecting on my blunder.
It is a grave issue that cannot simply be overlooked.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In the final stretch of the race... I surrendered myself to pure passion and ran purely on competitive spite.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was nearly overwhelmed and swallowed up
by the roaring spirits of Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……I felt that I was going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yet in the next instant, my inner passion cried out.
Refusing to lose. Telling me to bite down and hold on!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The blood boiled throughout my entire body, and I snapped.
I couldn't stop my sprinting legs.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I must have been on the verge of running out of control.
choice_data_list: Still, that's exactly why it was such a great match.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I am satisfied with today's race as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was able to have a wonderful showdown with Chiyono O-san and Ardan-san.
And I believe I gave the best run I possibly could.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was the best I could do right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't cast off my restraints,
I never would have been able to challenge the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot overlook my own inadequacy and immaturity
that caused this.
choice_data_list: Sometimes it comes down to a clash of fighting spirit at the very end.

text_block_list.text:
When racers are evenly matched and neck and neck,
it's often the one with the stronger fighting spirit who prevails.

"Today's race was precisely that kind of situation.
I reassure her that there's no reason to be pessimistic."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However... if placed in the same situation again,
the possibility of her losing control in the future is not zero.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"To accept such an unstable running style
and see it through to the end is..."
choice_data_list: Then let's further master "Fire and Water as One."

text_block_list.text:
Elevate the level of both running and tactics.
Doing so should reduce the situations where you cannot win
without removing your restraints.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—I agree.
I'm also in favor of that plan.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... I am relieved to hear
that you share the same view, Trainer-dono."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please guide me well
so that I can run consistently at the Kikuka Sho.
The final race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho. In all likelihood, Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will be running as well.
choice_data_list: Looks like we're in for another tough battle.
Looks like we're in for another tough battle, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. However, I am looking forward to it as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Because with you and the others, Chiyono O-san,
we can strive for a battle that surpasses even today's.

Reaching even greater heights with them at the Kikuka Sho.
Yaeno Muteki's smile spoke volumes.
However, a few days later—

Word arrived that both Sakura Chiyono O
and Mejiro Ardan would be sitting out of races
for a while due to injuries.
